feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Police fear missing woman 'may have come to harm' as man in court charged with murder
articles.summary: A man has appeared in court charged with murder after detectives investigating the disappearance of a young woman said they have to "consider the possibility that she may have come to harm".

articles.title: London Underground strike to go ahead after talks break down
articles.summary: A 24-hour strike by London Tube drivers is set to go ahead this week after talks failed to resolves the dispute.

articles.title: Millwall FC face partial stadium closure over 'offensive' chanting
articles.summary: Millwall have been punished with a partial stadium closure after two FA crowd rule breaches for ableist and homophobic chanting.

articles.title: NHS England chief executive to step down in spring
articles.summary: The head of NHS England is stepping down ahead of the body's abolition next year.

articles.title: FA chair had to sign NDA to view FIFA documents on World Cup sell-off
articles.summary: Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt has now viewed some FIFA documents on the World Cup sell-off but had to sign a nondisclosure agreement, Sky News has learned.

articles.title: Baby P's mother loses latest bid for prison release
articles.summary: Baby P's mother has lost her latest bid to be released from prison - but the Parole Board has recommended she is moved to an open jail.

articles.title: Two men arrested over suspected burglary at William and Kate's home
articles.summary: Two men have been arrested over a suspected burglary at William and Kate's Norfolk home.

articles.title: Inmate who murdered Ian Huntley given second whole-life prison sentence
articles.summary: An inmate who murdered Soham killer Ian Huntley has been sentenced to a second whole-life prison term.

articles.title: League Two footballer charged with rape
articles.summary: A League Two footballer has been charged with three counts of rape and one count of engaging in sexual communication with a child.

articles.title: Heat deaths up 76% on previous record as total reaches new high in England
articles.summary: Heat deaths reached a record high this year in England, new data shows.
